_note: SL-007 review m1, m2 and m6, closed as their classes. The rules are the settled entries of .taad/fitness.yaml under '# settled by SL-007', read from there by SettledRulesCorpusTests (their only copy). Each class is bounded by who produces its members, which is whoever edits src/FsAnalyser.App next, by accident and not to get past a rule. 'argsRule': the spellings of StartupEventArgs.Args, GetCommandLineArgs and the property pattern that read the arguments before CommandLine.Arguments has repaired them. 'rebuiltRule': the spellings of the rebuilt command line. 'writeRule': the BCL's openers that open an entry already at the name and write through it. Each row is one line of code: expect 'fire' means some pattern of the rule matches it, 'quiet' that none does. 'before' says what the patterns attempt 1 left in the file (and the engine's first append) did with the row, kept so that the rows the widening closed stay shown: the rows that were 'quiet' and now fire are the ones the fix closed.
